labeling_rules.annotator_guidance: Given question, answer, citations, and retrieval context, label the desired terminal route as auto or human. Never label auto for unmeasured quality, missing citations on substantial claims, or judge outage. Prefer human on ambiguity (cost of false auto is higher).
